text:
Maria G: Quick async for BlackRock private cutover tomorrow. Need explicit owners for: egress whitelist, cert rotation flow, and airgap signing key exchange. Who's on what?

Joel H: I can own egress whitelist. Customer asked for our source IPs + staging CIDR. Who has the latest NAT list? :eyes: 

Sang (NetOps): I have staging pool, not the prod NAT allocations yet. @Maria G can you confirm prod ranges for Dedicated? Ill file the NetOps CR once confirmed.

Maria G: Prod NATs are below for Dedicated pool (copy from infra):
```
34.82.200.16/28
34.82.200.32/28
```
Staging CIDR: `10.250.7.0/24`  share with their staging ops.

Priya K: Heads-up: airgap artifact signing key not in their offline registry. That's blocking image sync. ops-bot also flagged missing key in CI.

Anya (SE): Ill reach out to their infra lead. Can someone paste the key fingerprint format they expect? Ill mirror into their channel.

Maria G: Fingerprint format: `SHA256:<base64>` (OpenPGP). Ill DM the actual fingerprint to Anya after this thread. Also need cert rotation decision who will handle private endpoint certs (Platform vs customer).

Joel H: I thought Platform automates cert issuance but customer wants keys in their HSM. @Sang do you want Platform to own CSR issuance and rotation reminders, and let customer SRE hold keys?

Sang (NetOps): Yes, thats what we discussed. Platform will provide an automated CSR + rotation schedule. Customer keeps private keys on their HSM and performs key installation. Ill draft the CSR steps and post as a runbook.

ops-bot: Deploy-check failed for `blackrock/private-onboard`  missing secret `artifact-signing-key` in vault. CI: https://ci.redwood/prod/blackrock/462 :warning:

Priya K: Thats the blocker. Anya  have you confirmed contact? Ill prepare the key upload playbook (approval steps included).

Anya (SE): Contact confirmed: daniel.s@blackrock.com. Im emailing him with the `artifact-signing-key` spec and examples.

Joel H: If prod NATs arent whitelisted in time, customer asked for a fallback. Proposal: route initial traffic to Hosted (strict routing policy) for 48h, then cut to Private once whitelist confirmed. Thoughts?

Maria G: PM approved fallback. Hosted fallback for first 48h. We need an automated routing policy to flip to Hosted on missing whitelist, and then cut back. @Sang can you add a canary route + policy?

Sang (NetOps): Yep. Adding canary route now. Policy id `blackrock-canary-2026-v1`. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/routing/pulls/627 — will link smoke test. :thumbsup:

Anya (SE): One small code review reminder: preflight script uses `--staging-cidr` flag but PR review pending. Link: https://git.redwood/onboard/preflight/pull/89  @Joel H can you take a look by EOD?

Joel H: On my radar, will review tonight and leave comments.

Maria G: Recap/action items:
- Egress owner: Joel H  provide final IP list to customer + file anything else needed (prod NATs posted above).
- NetOps: Sang  CSR runbook + add canary routing policy (PR linked).
- Artifact signing: Anya + Priya  contact customer and get `artifact-signing-key` into their offline registry (CI failing until present).
- Certs: Platform to generate CSR and rotation schedule; customer SRE holds private keys on HSM.
- Fallback: Hosted route for 48h if whitelist delayed; automated routing policy to be added.

Target cutover: TOMORROW 10:00 UTC. Please reply if I missed anything or if owners want to swap. :rocket:
